name: logo-cloud
title: Logo cloud
description: A row of customer or partner logos under a short label.

frame.summary: A label above a wrapping <ul> of images.

regions.name: logos
regions.collapse: flex-wrap; never a horizontally scrolling or marquee strip.

components.name: text
components.for: The label, role supporting, tone muted.

logos.type: Array<{ src: string; name: string; href?: string }>
logos.a11y: Each image's alt is the company name; a logo is content here, not decoration.

behavior.summary: Static. The label is text, not a heading, by default.

decisions.decision: The label is not a heading by default
decisions.why: "Trusted by" is not a section anyone navigates to; a heading would add noise to the outline between the hero and the next real section.
Motion that cannot be paused fails WCAG 2.2.2, and a moving strip is the opposite of scannable.

decisions.decision: Logos keep their own colours or are all monochrome — the caller's call, not a CSS filter
decisions.why: A filter that greys logos changes contrast unpredictably; supplying monochrome assets is the only verifiable route.

obligations: alt text is the company name.
Linked logos need the destination to be the company, not a dead link.

native.reason: Website-only by decision B3 (gate-1 review, docs/decisions/2026-11-gate-1-review.md): marketing blocks and templates ship on the web only and get no native version. Marketing composition. A native app is reached after install, so there is nothing to persuade or convert; the equivalent content in-app is an onboarding or paywall screen, which is a different block with different obligations.

tokenGaps.interim: Logos are capped at block-size var(--rata-size-control-lg), the same derive-from-controls habit as Dialog widths.
